summary: Validated the four new LedgerSync features. Backend: 13/13 new pytest cases pass (cron auth 401, cron 200+accepted, duplicate X-Webhook-Id, CSV download w/ correct headers & rows, /accounting/status shape with configured:false, qbo/xero connect 400 'not configured', disconnect ok:true). Frontend: founder login works, Listener page shows pulsing LIVE indicator and live block height (updates after ~5-6s, started at '—' then populated to 52,343,793), Invoices page export-csv-button triggers download of 'ledgersync-payments.csv', ERP Sync page shows QBO + Xero cards, both disabled 'Awaiting credentials' buttons, MOCK mode note, and sync-logs table has a 'Mode' column with MOCK rows. No console errors.

issues: Status badge on the two connection cards shows 'CANCELED' when the server has no credentials configured. 'CANCELED' is misleading wording for a never-connected provider; a label like 'NOT CONFIGURED' or 'DISCONNECTED' would read better.
Initial block-height-display renders '—' until first status fetch resolves (~1 cycle). Harmless but a skeleton/loading state would be nicer than an em-dash.

action_items: (Optional) Rename 'CANCELED' badge on QBO/Xero cards when provider is unconfigured to 'NOT CONFIGURED' or 'DISCONNECTED' for clearer UX.
(Optional) Add a 1-tick loading placeholder for block-height-display instead of em-dash.
critical_code_review_comments: cron_bill_subscriptions uses hmac.compare_digest for the secret and dedups via X-Webhook-Id — good. Runs the actual work in a BackgroundTask so the HTTP ack is immediate.
bill_due_subscriptions is race-safe: the subscription advance is an atomic conditional update on (id, status=ACTIVE, nextBillingDate=cur) so parallel cron runs can't double-bill.
export_payments_csv streams via StringIO Response with correct text/csv + Content-Disposition. For >5k invoices it could grow; consider StreamingResponse later.
run_erp_sync now writes mode='live'|'mock' on each erp_sync_logs row (new field) and gracefully falls back to mock when provider is set but keys/connection are absent.
/api/accounting/qbo/connect correctly returns 400 'QUICKBOOKS credentials are not configured on the server yet' when QBO_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are empty (same for Xero).
server.py is now 1200 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, invoices, cron, erp, listener).
seed_data_creation: Cron run accepted a background bill job (no due subscriptions in the past so no new invoice created). A cron_runs doc was inserted for the dedup test. No stray business data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New-feature tests at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_new_features.py -v -o addopts=''`. WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET is set in backend/.env; QBO/Xero client keys are intentionally empty so only the 'not configured' / MOCK branch is exercised.
